build_impala_learner: build an IMPALALearner instance with an environment spec, Sonnet RNNCore network, and Reverb dataset
run_learner_step: run a single SGD step on the IMPALALearner that computes VTrace losses and logs metrics
create_learner_checkpoint: create a checkpoint of the IMPALALearner network and optimizer state via the state property
get_learner_variables: get the IMPALALearner network variables as a list of numpy arrays using get_variables
review_vtrace_loss_computation: review the IMPALALearner _step method to understand VTrace importance-weighted actor-critic loss computation
